cards.example_en: People of every race cheered at the school concert.
cards.example_zh: 学校音乐会上，各个种族的人都在欢呼。

cards.example_en: News on the radio said the football match was cancelled.
cards.example_zh: 收音机里的新闻说足球比赛取消了。

cards.example_en: The railway crosses the wide river on a high bridge.
cards.example_zh: 铁路从一座高桥上越过宽阔的河面。

cards.example_en: Heavy rain soaked our school bags on the way home.
cards.example_zh: 回家路上，大雨把我们的书包淋湿了。

cards.example_en: A rainbow appeared after the rain.
cards.example_zh: 雨后出现了一道彩虹。

cards.example_en: Ticket sales will raise money for the new library books.
cards.example_zh: 门票收入将为图书馆的新书筹集资金。

cards.example_en: The city has seen rapid change.
cards.example_zh: 这座城市变化很快。

cards.example_en: I would rather stay at home today.
cards.example_zh: 我今天宁愿待在家里。

cards.example_en: We usually reach the stadium before the match starts.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常在比赛开始前到达体育场。

cards.example_en: I read the bus timetable while I wait outside.
cards.example_zh: 我在外面等车时读公交时刻表。

cards.example_en: Are you ready for the spelling test this afternoon?
cards.example_zh: 你准备好今天下午的拼写测验了吗？

cards.example_en: The film used real animals instead of drawings.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影用了真实的动物，而不是图画。

cards.example_en: I didn't realise the library closes early on Wednesday.
cards.example_zh: 我没有意识到图书馆星期三提早关门。

cards.example_en: I really enjoyed the school play.
cards.example_zh: 我真的很喜欢这次校园剧。

cards.example_en: She gave a clear reason for changing the picnic date.
cards.example_zh: 她清楚地说明了野餐改期的道理。

cards.example_en: Did you receive the parcel from your aunt today?
cards.example_zh: 你今天收到阿姨寄来的包裹了吗？

cards.example_en: A recent storm broke several branches in the park.
cards.example_zh: 最近的一场暴风雨折断了公园里的几根树枝。

cards.example_en: I didn't recognise my cousin in his new school uniform.
cards.example_zh: 我没有认出穿着新校服的表哥。

cards.example_en: Our teacher will recommend two novels for the holiday.
cards.example_zh: 我们老师会为假期推荐两本小说。

cards.example_en: She set a school record in the hundred-metre sprint.
cards.example_zh: 她创下了学校百米短跑的纪录。

cards.example_en: We should recycle paper and bottles.
cards.example_zh: 我们应该回收纸和瓶子。

cards.example_en: Her red scarf stood out in the snowy playground.
cards.example_zh: 她的红围巾在积雪的操场上很显眼。

cards.example_en: Walking to school can reduce the family's fuel costs.
cards.example_zh: 步行上学可以减少家里的油费开支。

cards.example_en: She might refuse the extra cake because she is full.
cards.example_zh: 她可能会拒绝多出来的蛋糕，因为她已经吃饱了。

cards.example_en: I regret not starting earlier.
cards.example_zh: 我后悔没有早点开始。

cards.example_en: She has a good relationship with her parents.
cards.example_zh: 她与父母关系良好。

cards.example_en: A relative brought mooncakes from her hometown.
cards.example_zh: 一位亲戚从老家带来了月饼。

cards.example_en: Listening to music helps me relax.
cards.example_zh: 听音乐可以帮助我放松。

cards.example_en: Passengers remain in their seats until the bus stops.
cards.example_zh: 乘客要留在座位上，直到公交车停下。

cards.example_en: Remember to close the door.
cards.example_zh: 记得关门。

cards.example_en: These signs remind drivers to slow down near the school.
cards.example_zh: 这些标志提醒司机在学校附近减速。

cards.example_en: Dad can repair my bike this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸这周末能给我修自行车。

cards.example_en: Could you repeat the address so I can write it?
cards.example_zh: 你能把地址再重复一遍，好让我写下来吗？

cards.example_en: I am still waiting for a reply from the chess club.
cards.example_zh: 我还在等国际象棋社团的回复。

cards.example_en: She gave a report on the class trip to the head teacher.
cards.example_zh: 她向校长汇报了班级出行的情况。

cards.example_en: This form will require a parent's signature by Friday.
cards.example_zh: 这张表格需要家长在星期五前签字。

cards.example_en: She won a prize at the fair for research on local bees.
cards.example_zh: 她对本地蜜蜂的研究在集市上得了奖。

cards.example_en: We show respect by queueing calmly for the school bus.
cards.example_zh: 我们平静地排队等校车，以此表示尊重。

cards.example_en: Everyone is responsible for keeping the classroom clean.
cards.example_zh: 每个人都有责任保持教室干净整洁。

cards.example_en: A short rest on the bench soon cooled us down.
cards.example_zh: 在长椅上稍作休息后，我们很快凉快了下来。

cards.example_en: We shared dumplings at a restaurant near the station.
cards.example_zh: 我们在车站附近的一家菜馆分着吃了饺子。

cards.example_en: Teachers posted the vote result on the noticeboard after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，老师们把投票结果贴在了布告栏上。

cards.example_en: Remember to return the library books before Friday.
cards.example_zh: 记得在星期五之前归还图书馆的书。

cards.example_en: A brief review of those dates helped me on the quiz.
cards.example_zh: 把那些日期简要复习一下，对我答题很有帮助。

cards.example_en: Hot rice and fried eggs were ready when I got home.
cards.example_zh: 我到家时，热白米和煎蛋已经准备好了。

cards.example_en: A rich family donated books to our school library.
cards.example_zh: 一个富有的家庭向我们学校图书馆捐赠了图书。

cards.example_en: Children ride their bikes along the river after school.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们放学后沿着河边骑自行车。

cards.example_en: The library sits on the right of the main school gate.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆在学校大门的右边。

cards.example_en: I will ring the office if the bus arrives late.
cards.example_zh: 如果公交车晚点，我会给办公室打电话。

cards.example_en: The sun will rise behind the hills before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 太阳会在早饭前从山丘后面升起。

word.example_en: She is ready to explain the chart.
Are you ready for the sports day?
word.example_zh: 你为运动会做好准备了吗？

word.example_en: This song can remind me of spring.
word.example_zh: 这首歌能使我想起春天。

word.example_en: In respect of time, the plan is tight.
word.example_zh: 就时间来说，这个计划很紧。

word.example_en: With respect to cost, the second plan wins.
word.example_zh: 就费用而言，第二个计划更好。

word.example_en: We stood out of respect for the speaker.
word.example_zh: 我们出于对演讲者的尊敬站了起来。

word.example_en: I am responsible for watering the plants.
Sit down and have a rest.
Haste can result in a costly error.
word.example_zh: 匆忙可能导致代价很大的错误。

word.example_en: The error may result from haste.
word.example_zh: 这个错误可能由匆忙导致。

word.example_en: A rumour can give rise to panic.
